clauses.title: Scope – Gives specifications
clauses.text: 1.    Scope - Gives specifications for hexagon head botts with threads from M5 up to and including M64 of product grade C.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: 2. Dimensions  M5, M6, M8, M10, M12, M16, M20, M24,  M30,  M36,  M42,   M48,  M56  and  M64. Note - For details,of preferred and non preferred threads refer to Tables 1 and 2 of the standard. SUMMARY OF IS  1363 (Part 1) : 2002 ISO 4016 : 1999 HEXAGON HEAD BOLTS, SCREWS AND NUTS OF PRODUCT GRADE C PART  1 : HEXAGON HEAD BOLTS (SIZE RANGE M5 TO M64) (Fourth Revision)

clauses.title: Prefered threads – M5,
clauses.text: 2.1 Prefered threads - M5, M6 and M64

clauses.title: Non
clauses.text: 2.2  Non - Prfered threads - M14, M18, M22, M27, M33, M39,  M45,  M52, and M60
